DB（Diazine Black）在铜电镀微孔填充体系中用作**整平剂**：它是JGB的衍生物，填充性能可与JGB竞争，且被研究证实为有效的微孔填充整平剂 [E1][E2]。

具体作用：在含200 ppm PEG、60 ppm Cl⁻、1 ppm SPS的镀液中，少量DB可显著改善填充性能，最佳浓度为0.5–1 ppm（随微孔孔径而异）；浓度高于1 ppm时填充性能反而下降，这归因于各添加剂协同作用引起的CDA行为 [E5]。DB还与抑制剂、加速剂存在电化学相互作用，并影响镀层形貌、结晶取向及后续蚀刻速率 [E1][E2]。

It is important to study the interaction among SPS (accelerator), PEG (suppressor), and AB1 (leveler), as it provides a deeper understanding of the filling mechanism in microvias.<sup>45</sup> Traditionally, galvanostatic measurement is applied to study possible interactions by changing the injection order of the three types of additives. Fig. 1c (up) shows the change in cathodic potential after injecting additives into the testing solution. The cathodic potential declines (230 mV) after adding PEG, indicating its suppressing efect. Upon introducing AB1, the cathodic potential further decreases (31 mV), suggesting synergistic cooperation between AB1 and PEG. However, after the addition of SPS, the cathodic potential shifts positively (42 mV), indicating the accelerating efect of SPS in the presence of AB1 and PEG. By altering the additive injection order, SPS can cause a positive shift of 205 mV in cathodic potential after PEG injection, suggesting that SPS can replace PEG to accelerate copper electrodeposition, consistent with previous work.<sup>46</sup> Following AB1 injection, the cathodic potential changes negatively (-191 mV). Additionally, the potential reaches the same level regardless of injection order, further verifying the competition between SPS and AB1. It is important to study the interaction among SPS (accelerator), PEG (suppressor), and AB1 (leveler), as it provides a deeper understanding of the filling mechanism in microvias.<sup>45</sup> Traditionally, galvanostatic measurement is applied to study possible interactions by changing the injection order of the three types of additives. Fig. 1c (up) shows the change in cathodic potential after injecting additives into the testing solution. The cathodic potential declines (230 mV) after adding PEG, indicating its suppressing efect. Upon introducing AB1, the cathodic potential further decreases (31 mV), suggesting synergistic cooperation between AB1 and PEG. However, after the addition of SPS, the cathodic potential shifts positively (42 mV), indicating the accelerating efect of SPS in the presence of AB1 and PEG. By altering the additive injection order, SPS can cause a positive shift of 205 mV in cathodic potential after PEG injection, suggesting that SPS can replace PEG to accelerate copper electrodeposition, consistent with previous work.<sup>46</sup> Following AB1 injection, the cathodic potential changes negatively (-191 mV). Additionally, the potential reaches the same level regardless of injection order, further verifying the competition between SPS and AB1.
